policy_presence.summary: The retained scoped references are discoverable; no institution-wide semantic completion or permission is inferred.

ai_disclosure.summary: Adelaide identifies unacknowledged AI-generated information as potentially inappropriate use. Graduate researchers also have specific recordkeeping and thesis/publication acknowledgement requirements.

coursework.summary: Adelaide’s coursework procedure says course coordinators must inform students about appropriate GenAI use in the course. It does not grant blanket permission for every assignment.

exams.summary: For Adelaide’s invigilated online exams, the retained rules require explicitly approved tools and list AI tools such as ChatGPT among prohibited items. Check your exam instructions.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Adelaide Graduate Research School guidance tells graduate researchers not to upload sensitive, copyrighted or confidential information, or unprotected IP, into AI tools.

academic_integrity.summary: Adelaide’s policy identifies AI use that subverts an assignment or gives unfair advantage as misconduct, including passing AI-produced work off as one’s own. No general penalty is concluded here.

approved_tools.summary: The retained Adelaide tool records do not establish current account eligibility or costs. Institutional access is separate from course and exam permission.

named_ai_services.summary: Tool discovery is separate from assessment permission; current eligibility and complete product terms remain pending.

teaching_guidance.summary: Adelaide course coordinators are responsible for informing students about appropriate GenAI use and relevant scholarly or professional conventions for the assessment.

research_guidance.summary: Adelaide graduate researchers must discuss AI use with supervisors, keep records and acknowledge use. The authorship procedure allows readability support, requires transparent disclosure and excludes AI authorship.

security_procurement.summary: Adelaide’s Cyber Security Policy places AI systems under the same cyber security, data protection and compliance requirements as other information systems. It does not certify a particular tool.
